raw_text:
The "三维模型" tab (3D Model) is in the ribbon tab row.

{"x": 79, "y": 36}

The geometric tolerance is the feature control frame (perpendicularity 0.03 A), so I'll click on it.

{"x": 652, "y": 181}

The "平面" (Plane) button in the Work Features group is the one that creates a reference plane.

{"x": 641, "y": 77}

The "clipboard" most likely refers to the paste button in the WPS ribbon, labeled 粘贴, at the left of the ribbon.

{"x": 611, "y": 57}

The "更多" (More) tab in the extrude dialog is the most likely target for "more options".

{"x": 366, "y": 180}

"Scan" in Chinese is 扫描, which appears at the top of the ribbon (Sweep) at around (153, 77).

{"x": 140, "y": 77}

Clicking the V6 track label focuses that track.

{"x": 426, "y": 241}

The input file browse button is the folder icon next to the audio file path, in the top row.

{"x": 426, "y": 239}

The vertical zoom bar on the right has handles at y=10, 240 (end of the video track section), then 255 and 388 (audio track). The video track zoom bar spans y=10 to y=240, so its bottom handle is at the lower end.

{"x": 664, "y": 240}

The eyedropper icon sits at about (786, 219) in the toolbar.

{"x": 786, "y": 219}

The draw tool in the Piano roll toolbar is the pencil icon, at about x=426, y=94.

{"x": 426, "y": 95}

The scale bar is the thumbnail zoom slider at the bottom of the panel, running from about x=158 to x=221 at y=388.

{"x": 195, "y": 389}

Opening the containing folders of Alicia's Keys means using the "Instruments" dropdown below the Alicia's Keys banner in the Libraries panel.

{"x": 426, "y": 275}

Target bitrate value "19" is at (427, 241); it's an editable value field.

{"x": 427, "y": 241}

The "Move the camera view" most likely refers to the hand (pan) gizmo icon in the viewport.

{"x": 428, "y": 237}

The Solo button for A1 is the "S" next to M in the Audio 1 track header.

{"x": 427, "y": 245}

The tooltip says "Viewport Shading ... Rendered", which refers to the rendered shading button at about (427, 62). The instruction "Toggle viewpoint shading" most likely means that button.

{"x": 427, "y": 62}

The Copy button is in the toolbar, among the cut/copy/paste icons. Cut is at x=119, copy at x=142, paste at x=165.

{"x": 142, "y": 63}

The toolbar has New (133), Open (157), Save (181), Save All (205) icons. Save All is the stacked-disk icon at x≈203.

{"x": 204, "y": 84}

The largest file explorer is the "This PC" window in the background, and its close button is at the top right, around x=1543, y=13.

{"x": 1543, "y": 13}

Standard Colors row: dark red, red, orange, yellow, light green, ... Yellow is at x=476, y=300.

{"x": 476, "y": 300}

The snap dropdown is open, and "Step" is the currently selected item. To adjust the step size, I'd click the "Step" option.

{"x": 417, "y": 259}

The status bar shows "模式: 编辑" (Mode: Edit). Clicking it should toggle the mode.

{"x": 604, "y": 422}

The "interrupt" (break) button in the Stata toolbar is the red X circle at approximately (328, 66).

{"x": 329, "y": 66}

The print icon in Stata's toolbar is the printer icon, third from the left at about x=360, y=191.

{"x": 360, "y": 191}

The cell for y1 is row 1 in column B(Y), which is already highlighted.

{"x": 267, "y": 239}

The x axis column is A(X), and its "长名称" (long name) cell is at row y≈174, x≈199.

{"x": 199, "y": 174}

The "tools" control is most likely the sliders icon in the toolbar, at around x=579, y=372.

{"x": 579, "y": 372}

The qualifier toolbar has icons: picker, picker subtract, picker add, feather subtract (575), feather add (605), and the last (634) is the reset or denoise. "Feather add" is the pen with a plus, at 605.

{"x": 605, "y": 374}

The refresh icon (circular arrows) in the git log toolbar is at about (715, 403).

{"x": 715, "y": 404}

The emulator toolbar has a back triangle icon at (642, 359), which navigates back in the virtual device.

{"x": 642, "y": 359}

The thumbnail of the last picture taken is the small circular image at the right of the camera view.

{"x": 639, "y": 358}

The README.md under the Datasets folder is at y=276.

{"x": 127, "y": 276}

The share icon in the Preview toolbar is at (576, 199).

{"x": 576, "y": 199}

The terminal window's traffic-light buttons are at its top-left: close at 564, minimize at 584, zoom at 604. The minimize button is the middle one.

{"x": 584, "y": 216}

Sending Ctrl-Alt-Del opens the task manager in a Windows VM, so the target is the "Send Ctrl-Alt-Del" menu item.

{"x": 361, "y": 373}

The YColor row has a color swatch with a dropdown arrow, so I'd click the dropdown arrow beside the swatch.

{"x": 426, "y": 240}

The first row's initial point field (x0x) is most likely the one for variable x.

{"x": 428, "y": 241}

The "Quick search" text field in the sidebar is the search filter.

{"x": 162, "y": 358}

The email page is most likely the mail icon in the left sidebar, or the Inbox tab. "Back to email page" points to the Inbox tab.

{"x": 568, "y": 360}

The downloads/progress indicator in Firefox toolbar... The icon at (579, 96) looks like a circular progress icon (possibly the "Firefox updates/ downloads" icon). Likely it's the downloads button.

{"x": 579, "y": 96}

The "Remove Entry" button in the Environment Editor dialog is the one that removes the selected variable.

{"x": 576, "y": 360}

There are two "slight left onto Hancock Street" entries, steps 4 and 5. The instruction is ambiguous, so I'll pick the first one, step 4, and click its direction icon.

{"x": 57, "y": 239}

The ice cream product is likely the Coco Whip container.

{"x": 579, "y": 270}

The sort direction icon sits to the right of the "Created date" dropdown.

{"x": 757, "y": 240}

The arrow next to the sort dropdown toggles sort direction. It currently points up (ascending), and clicking it switches to descending.

{"x": 763, "y": 239}
